major_findings: W08-709 now retains the full child-palace follow-on star list: 刑耗煞曜、阴煞、大耗、天虚、破碎、蜚廉.
W08-713 is explicitly gated by the preceding 太阳化忌 plus 天刑 litigation context; it is not a general career recommendation.
W08-726 preserves 化禄化忌皆然 for the 子午巨门 + 桃花 performance scene.
W08-732 is a labor-intensive/mobile professional scene; the source does not establish a monetary cost variable.
W08-735 corrects the historical candidate's narrowed 辰-only scope to the printed 辰戌 scope.
W08-738…739 preserve the local paragraph context of the retail/customer passage without asserting a universal all-palace rule.
W08-740 preserves the source's combined 巨门化忌及会天机化忌 condition and does not broaden it to OR.
Four source-ordered PATH_DEPENDENT_GATE annotations are retained without assigning fixed durations or probabilities; 早年/中年后 remain source life-stage qualifiers only.
No source-text ambiguity or shared-semantic gap was discovered in this bounded printed-p86–p87 section.

records.canonical_condition: 巨门守财帛总论
records.source_digest: 巨门守财帛宫，基本性质为劳心费神以求财，或主以口舌求财。
records.source_note: Direct source-first recheck against the approved physical PDF page images for printed p86–p87. The historical CSV row is an indexing aid only; source wording and prerequisites control.

records.canonical_condition: 巨门守财帛宫且心高气傲
records.source_digest: 且不宜心高气傲，否则必生破败。
records.source_note: The source states a conditional risk (心高气傲→必生破败), not merely a general instruction to avoid arrogance.

records.canonical_condition: 巨门化禄
records.source_digest: 巨门化禄，亦仅主利于口舌求财，如律师、教师、推销、传播、表演等行业。
records.source_note: Direct source-first recheck against the approved physical PDF page images for printed p86–p87. The historical CSV row is an indexing aid only; source wording and prerequisites control.

records.canonical_condition: 巨门化忌；以口舌求财为宜，否则多是非词讼
records.source_digest: 巨门化忌者尤然，否则必多是非词讼。
records.source_note: Retains the source's explicit otherwise-condition instead of collapsing speech income and disputes into an unconditional combined effect.

records.archived_candidate_condition: 巨门会禄权科及辅佐吉曜
records.canonical_condition: 巨门坐财帛宫；禄、权、科同会且更见辅佐吉曜
records.source_digest: 巨门坐财帛宫，有禄、权、科同会，更见辅佐吉曜，必可成富。
records.source_note: The source's strong wealth claim requires both the stated transformation meeting and auxiliary auspicious stars.

records.canonical_condition: 前格锋芒毕露盛气凌人
records.source_digest: 唯若锋芒毕露，盛气凌人者，必反遭人排挤，以致失败。
records.source_note: Direct source-first recheck against the approved physical PDF page images for printed p86–p87. The historical CSV row is an indexing aid only; source wording and prerequisites control.

records.canonical_condition: 巨门之财不过一代
records.source_digest: 巨门之财，不过一代。故凡巨门坐财帛宫，宜兼视子女宫，子女宫不吉者，主子女散财。
records.source_note: Direct source-first recheck against the approved physical PDF page images for printed p86–p87. The historical CSV row is an indexing aid only; source wording and prerequisites control.

records.source_digest: 更见刑耗煞曜，及阴煞、大耗、天虚、破碎、蜚廉诸曜，则子女因牵涉官非而破败，或骄奢致败。

records.source_note: The source says 太阳化忌亦主生极大口舌 in this section; it does not independently state a special Sun–Gumen aspect requirement here.

records.source_note: Keeps the favorable occupational scene attached to the preceding Gumen–Yang–Tianxing configuration.

records.archived_candidate_condition: 巨门与太阳同度对照有吉化或命宫禄马
records.canonical_condition: 巨门与太阳同度或对照且有吉化；或命宫见禄马交驰
records.source_digest: 巨门与太阳同度或对照，有吉化者，或命宫见禄马交驰者，主一生受异族信赖而成富。

records.source_digest: 子午宫巨门与天机相对，见禄，为『石中隐玉格』，主中年后脱颖而出，突成巨富。

records.archived_candidate_condition: 子午巨门无吉化但禄存火铃刑耗

records.canonical_condition: 辰戌巨门对天同
records.source_digest: 辰戌宫巨门与天同相对，主白手创业，且以专业为宜，因之可以成富。

records.canonical_condition: 辰戌巨门处罗网且为陷地
records.source_digest: 辰戌为罗网，又为巨门陷地，故亦主奔波劳累。所从事专业亦以带奔忙性质者为宜，如建筑地盘工程师、航业工程、运输工程等。
records.source_note: The source describes labor/travel and busy professional scenes, not a separate monetary cost.

records.canonical_condition: 辰戌巨门见煞
records.source_digest: 辰戌巨门与煞曜同度，奔波尤甚。
records.source_note: Direct source-first recheck against the approved physical PDF page images for printed p86–p87. The historical CSV row is an indexing aid only; source wording and prerequisites control.

records.archived_candidate_condition: 辰戌巨门无禄权科辅吉魁钺

records.canonical_condition: 辰戌宫巨门化忌（反格）
records.source_digest: 辰戌巨门化忌者，为反格，可得意外高职(如未有足够资历，却能得任需资历之职位)，因而收丰厚。
records.source_note: The printed source explicitly says 辰戌巨门化忌; the historical candidate incorrectly narrowed this to 辰 only.

records.canonical_condition: 巳亥巨门对太阳

records.canonical_condition: 巳亥巨门见太阳化禄
records.source_digest: 巳亥巨门见太阳化禄，亦主受异族推崇，在异族中有信誉。
records.source_note: Direct source-first recheck against the approved physical PDF page images for printed p86–p87. The historical CSV row is an indexing aid only; source wording and prerequisites control.

records.source_note: The source uses 及, not 或; the candidate's OR condition would broaden the trigger beyond the printed wording.

records.canonical_condition: 巳亥宫巨门化权
records.source_digest: 巨门化为权星，在巳亥宫，必须从事[口舌生财]的行业。
records.source_note: The explicit palace-position gate remains attached to 巨门化权.

records.canonical_condition: 巳亥巨门禄马交驰
records.source_digest: 巳亥巨门见禄马交驰之局，亦利在外地贸迁。在现代最宜日用品零售。
